mapper.select: select * from board order by b_ref desc, b_step asc

select * from ( select rank() over(order by b_ref desc , b_step asc) as no, b.*, (select nvl(count(*),0) from comment_tb where b_idx=b.b_idx) as cmt_count from (select * from board) b ) where no between #{ start } and #{ end }
select * from board where b_idx = #{ b_idx }
mapper.insert: insert into board ( b_idx, b_subject, b_content, b_ip, b_readhit, b_regdate, b_moddate, mem_idx, mem_id, b_ref, b_step, b_depth, b_use, mem_name )values( seq_board_b_idx.nextVal, #{b_subject}, #{b_content} , #{b_ip} , 0 , sysdate , sysdate , #{mem_idx} , #{mem_id} , seq_board_b_idx.currVal , 0 , 0 , 'y' , #{mem_name} )

insert into board ( b_idx, b_subject, b_content, b_ip, b_readhit, b_regdate, b_moddate, mem_idx, mem_id, b_ref, b_step, b_depth, b_use, mem_name )values( seq_board_b_idx.nextVal, #{b_subject}, #{b_content} , #{b_ip} , 0 , sysdate , sysdate , #{mem_idx} , #{mem_id} , #{b_ref} , #{b_step} , #{b_depth} , 'y' , #{mem_name} )
mapper.update: UPDATE board set b_subject = #{b_subject}, b_content = #{b_content}, b_moddate = SYSDATE WHERE b_idx = #{b_idx}
update board set b_readhit = b_readhit + 1 where b_idx = #{ b_idx}
update board set b_step = b_step + 1 where b_ref=#{ b_ref} and b_step > #{ b_step}
update board set b_use='n' where b_idx=#{ b_idx }
